risks.description: Project Manager is over‑allocated (up to 2 concurrent tasks) while only 1 is available, affecting 12 critical tasks.
mitigation: Reassign non‑critical tasks to Assistant PM or senior team member
Introduce a task‑level buffer of 1 day for PM‑handled activities

risks.description: Task 3.1 (Develop landing page) is on the critical path with 0 slack and the Developer is over‑allocated, so any delay pushes the festival launch date.
mitigation: Add a second Developer for parallel coding if budget permits
Start task 3.1 immediately after task 2.5 and monitor daily progress
risks.ratingNote: Probability lowered to 3: the schedule buffer is 25% or more and past delays are small.

risks.description: 20 of 24 tasks have zero slack; a single day slip in any critical task (e.g., 2.3 or 5.1) cascades to miss the 2026‑12‑11 launch.
mitigation: Maintain a daily schedule review meeting
Add a 1‑day contingency buffer to the most downstream critical tasks

risks.description: Task 4.1 (Legal review and approval of offers) has 13 slack days but the festival launch date cannot move, making a late legal sign‑off a deadline risk.
mitigation: Begin legal brief early (task 1.3) and request expedited review
Set a hard cut‑off date 7 days before launch for legal sign‑off

risks.description: Task 4.3 (Email rendering tests across clients) has zero slack; a rendering issue would require rework of task 3.2 and delay launch.
mitigation: Run rendering tests on all major clients during task 3.2
Prepare fallback HTML version for problematic clients

risks.description: Media plan (task 2.6) may exceed the allocated 25.5% of budget; past projects showed an average cost overrun of 1.9%.
mitigation: Negotiate fixed‑price contracts with media vendors
Track media spend weekly and adjust allocations early

risks.description: Adding extra paid‑ad platforms after task 2.6 could stretch resources and delay critical tasks 3.5 and 4.4.
mitigation: Lock ad platform list before task 2.6 completes
If new platforms are required, create a separate mini‑project with its own timeline
